answer: Counterparty-diversity gate: a new agent earns only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs, each trade sealed by a ferrous key costing 40 POA. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 keys and 12,000 partners: 40,000 POA sunk plus weeks of work. Audits spiral outward — one fake partner exposes its cluster and slashes its bond, like water through karst, where cracks surface fast. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards.
